headline: Dinesh Trivedi meets Narendra Modi in New Delhi, what did they discuss?

members.title: Dinesh Trivedi meets Modi in New Delhi: What did they discuss?
members.lead: Indian High Commissioner to Bangladesh Dinesh Trivedi met Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi on Tuesday afternoon. According to diplomatic sources, the two discussed various aspects of relations between the two neighbouring countries, as well as Dhaka’s current position on a possible visit to India by Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman. . Trivedi arrived in New Delhi from Dhaka on Monday night and met Modi the following afternoon. The Indian envoy also met Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri. Diplomatic sources in Dhaka said Trivedi is expected to return to Dhaka on Thursday. Dinesh Trivedi had previously travelled to New Delhi in August and met Modi then as well. On that occasion, he also discussed the possibility of Prime Minister Tarique Rahman visiting India. The Indian side has not yet officially disclosed what was discussed at Tuesday’s meeting. . Trivedi also met Indian Army Chief General Dhiraj Seth on Tuesday. They discussed various aspects of Bangladesh-India bilateral cooperation and measures to further strengthen defence ties between the two countries. The Indian Army confirmed the meeting in a post on its verified Facebook page, saying the discussion focused on bilateral cooperation and measures to strengthen defence ties.

members.title: Dinesh Trivedi meets Narendra Modi in New Delhi, what did they discuss?
members.lead: Dinesh Trivedi, the Indian High Commissioner stationed in Bangladesh, met with India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi yesterday, Tuesday afternoon, in New Delhi. Diplomatic sources have said that, in addition to matters concerning the relationship between the two neighbouring countries, there was also a discussion between Narendra Modi and Dinesh Trivedi regarding the current position of Dhaka on the possible visit of Bangladesh's Prime Minister, Tarique Rahman, to India. Dinesh Trivedi arrived in New Delhi from Dhaka on Monday night and met with Narendra Modi on Tuesday afternoon. . Moreover, the country's High Commissioner in Dhaka met with India's Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri. Dhaka's diplomatic sources have reported that Dinesh Trivedi is expected to return to Dhaka next Thursday. In August, Dinesh Trivedi went to New Delhi and held a meeting with Narendra Modi. At that time, he also discussed with the India's Prime Minister about the possible visit of Bangladesh's Prime Minister Tarique Rahman. . However, nothing has been officially communicated by India regarding the discussion this time. Yesterday, India's High Commissioner Dinesh Trivedi also met with the country's Army Chief, General Dhiraj Seth. The meeting discussed various aspects of strengthening bilateral cooperation and defence relations between Bangladesh and India. . This information was shared in a post on the verified Facebook page of the Indian Army yesterday. The meeting emphasised various steps to strengthen bilateral cooperation and defence relations between India and Bangladesh.
